name: Monk Grounded Spirit
body:
Some monks devote themselves to being a balance point in the world. Seeing their role as one of harmony between all energies and mastering the flow of such power. Grounded spirits meditate to see the underpinnings of planes, gaining greater control over the flow of power which mortals use to weave their magic. Learning to disrupt the balance in spirits before them in order to overwhelm unwary foes who rely on magic over might; a grounded spirit is a force to be reckoned with.

Temper the Ephemeral (Su)

A grounded spirit understands the impact of magic on the world but also knows that magic is just another force of nature no different than the wind and can be overcome like any other. A grounded spirit uses Intelligence in place of Wisdom to determine the effectiveness of all monk abilities that normally rely on Wisdom.

Spellhardened (Su)

The bonus a grounded spirit gains to AC beyond their Intelligence modifier, gained at 4th level and every four levels thereafter, also applies on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

This ability modifies the monk’s AC bonus.

Redirect the Energy (Su)

At 4th level, the grounded spirit has learned to make enemy power their own. Whenever a grounded spirit successfully saves against an enemy spell or spell-like ability they gain a ki point. This does not allow the grounded spirit to have more than their normal maximum number of ki points.

This ability replaces slow fall.

Bonus Feats: Add the following feats to the list of bonus feats available to the monk at the listed level.

This ability modifies bonus feats.

2nd–Disruptive
6th–Spellbreaker
10th–Shatterspell, Sunder Blessing
14th-Teleport Tactition
Stifle the Flow (Su)

At 9th level, the grounded spirit can extend mastery of their own energy to the energies of others. Whenever an opponent fails their saving throw against the grounded spirit’s stunning fist, for one minute or until the next time that opponent casts a spell or uses a spell-like ability that opponent must succeed at a concentration check with a DC of 20 + twice the level of the spell being cast or the spell-like ability being used. Failure means the spell or spell-like ability fails and is expended with no effect.

This ability replaces improved evasion.

Sever Spirit (Su)

At 15th level, the grounded spirit has learned to block another’s ties to whatever source powers their magic. As a full round action a grounded spirit can send forth a wave of their own energy at a target within 30 ft. as a ranged touch attack or as a melee touch attack. If successful the target takes damage as though from the grounded spirit’s unarmed strike and must make a Fortitude save (DC of 10 + 1/2 the grounded spirit’s level + the grounded spirit’s Intelligence modifier) or lose the ability to cast spells or activate spell-like abilities. The target makes a new save each day when they would normally regain their spells or recharge spell-like abilities. This condition can be removed by a break enchantment spell or more powerful magic. Treat the caster level as equal to the grounded spirit’s class level to determine the strength of the effect for the purposes of such spells.

This ability replaces quivering palm.

Ki Expertise

The above expertise may be exchanged for any of the following monk abilities. high jump (5th), wholeness of body (7th), diamond body (11th), abundant step (12th), diamond soul (13th), timeless body (17th), tongue of the sun and moon (17th), empty body (19th), and perfect self (20th).

If the expertise requires spending a charge of stolen magic the grounded spirit may substitute 2 ki points and if the expertise refers to spelljack level it uses grounded spirit level instead.
